body: Credibility-generated forward test (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Probability 0.47 (naive sector base rate 0.41) that: Watts Water FY2026 reported net sales growth is >=17.0%. Probability set only by the pre-stated rule (research_notes/Promise tracker pilot/US_INDUSTRIALS_peer_comparison.md section 5 = AUTO_COMPONENTS_peer_comparison.md section 5, unchanged): p0 = 0.41 (leave-one-out peer strict delivery rate, category 'revenue_growth', n=8); SAC +15.3 pts x weight 0.375 (N=12) -> p = 0.47. Evidence: Q3-2026 call (05-Nov-2026): FY2026 reported sales growth guide 17-18% incl. ~$128-131 mn acquisition sales (raised from 8-12% in Feb, 14-17% in Aug). FY2025 net sales $2,438.5 mn (XBRL). 9M-2026 reported growth ~+20%. Resolution: YES if FY2026 net sales / FY2025 net sales - 1 >= 17.0%, to one decimal, both from the FY2026 Form 10-K XBRL (revenue, as first reported; prior year = the comparative in the same filing). Source: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts (FY2026 10-K). Resolve by 2027-03-15; score with Brier vs the base rate, to test whether the credibility adjustment adds skill.

data.adjustment_rule: p0 = leave-one-out pooled STRICT delivery rate (specificity-weighted share 'delivered'; partly=0) of the other 3 peers in the promise's category (all-category peer rate if <8 peer promises in that category). p = clip(p0 + N/(N+20) x SAC/100, 0.05, 0.95), N = company's scored promises, SAC in points (credit basis: delivered 1, partly 0.5; categories with n<5, or with <2 peers having data, pooled). P(base) = p0.
data.base_rate_reasoning: Naive forecaster = sector delivery rate for 'revenue_growth' promises among the other US industrials peers (strict: delivered only, specificity-weighted; n=8). No company-specific information.
data.resolution_rule: YES if FY2026 net sales / FY2025 net sales - 1 >= 17.0%, to one decimal, both from the FY2026 Form 10-K XBRL (revenue, as first reported; prior year = the comparative in the same filing).

title: Paper call: Watts Water FY2026 reported net sales growth is >=17.0%
